function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – What to Look For Below is a quick‑reference guide to the most common men’s underwear styles, what they’re good for, and when you might want to choose one over another. Pick the style that matches your activity level, comfort preference, and wardrobe needs. | Style | Key Features | Best For | Pros | Cons | |-------|--------------|----------|------|------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑leg, snug fit; full coverage; elastic waistband | Everyday wear, gym, travel | • Versatile, fits most body types
• Good support, less bunching | • Can feel tight if too snug
• May show seams under tight pants | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short leg, snug waistband; no side panels | Casual, office, light activity | • Minimal bulk, great for fitted pants
• Excellent support | • Limited coverage; may feel restrictive for larger hips | | **Trunks** | Shorter leg than briefs, snug fit; similar to boxer briefs but shorter | Athletic wear, hot climates | • Less bulk, good for compression gear
• Keeps you cool | • Less coverage; may not suit larger thighs | | **Boxers** | Loose fit, long leg, elastic waistband | Sleep, lounging, light day wear | • Breathable, airy feel
• No compression, great for sensitive skin | • Can bunch up, causing discomfort under tight pants | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight, supportive, often made of spandex blends | High‑intensity workouts, long flights | • Reduces muscle vibration, improves circulation
• Keeps everything in place | • Can feel restrictive; not ideal for everyday wear | | **Performance/Technical** | Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, quick‑dry fabrics | Outdoor activities, travel | • Keeps you dry, reduces odor
• Lightweight, breathable | • Usually pricier; may lack style options | | **Bamboo/Organic Cotton** | Eco‑friendly, soft, natural moisture control | Sensitive skin, eco‑conscious shoppers | • Hypoallergenic, breathable
• Sustainable | • Can be pricier; may wrinkle | | **Lace/Designer** | Decorative, often sheer or patterned | Special occasions, fashion statements | • Stylish, unique look
• Can be more breathable | • Not practical for everyday wear; may be less durable | --- #### How to Choose the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low activity / lounging** → Boxers or loose briefs. - **Moderate activity / commuting** → Boxer briefs or trunks. - **High activity / sports** → Compression briefs or performance fabrics. 2. **Fit Matters** - **Waistband**: Should sit comfortably at the natural waist without digging in. Elastic bands with a bit of give are usually best. - **Leg length**: Longer legs (boxer briefs/trunks) provide more coverage; shorter legs (briefs/trunks) reduce bulk. - **Support**: If you need extra support (e.g., for larger hips or during workouts), choose a snug style with a supportive pouch. 3. **Fabric Choice** - **Cotton**: Soft, breathable, but can absorb moisture. - **Polyester/Spandex blends**: Moisture‑wicking, stretch, quick‑dry. - **Bamboo/Organic**: Eco‑friendly, naturally antibacterial. - **Silk**: Luxurious feel, but less durable. 4. **Lifestyle & Wardrobe** - **Fit under pants**: If you wear slim or skinny jeans, a low‑profile brief or boxer brief works best. - **Travel**: Compression briefs or performance underwear keep you dry and reduce odor. - **Fashion**: Designer or lace styles can add flair to a night‑out outfit. 5. **Try Them On** - If possible, test a few styles in a store or order a sample pack online. Pay attention to how the waistband feels after a few hours and whether the fabric stays dry. --- #### Quick Recommendations | Situation | Suggested Style | Why | |-----------|-----------------|-----| | **Daily office wear** | Classic briefs or boxer briefs | Minimal bulk, good support | | **Gym / running** | Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs | Keeps everything in place, moisture‑wicking | | **Long flights** | Compression briefs or performance underwear | Reduces odor, stays dry | | **Hot summer days** | Boxers or trunks in breathable fabric | Keeps you cool, less bulk | | **Sensitive skin** | Bamboo or organic cotton | Hypoallergenic, breathable | | **Fashion statement** | Lace or designer briefs | Adds style, unique look | --- #### Final Thought There isn’t a single “best” style for everyone—comfort is subjective. The key is to match the underwear to your daily activities, body shape, and personal comfort preferences. Once you find a brand and fit that works, you’ll likely stick with it for years. Happy underwear hunting!
